name: yoto
description: Send audiobooks and series to Yoto Make Your Own (MYO) cards with 16x16 pixel icons and chapter customization.

client_id.title: Yoto OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from the Yoto Developer Portal.

client_secret.title: Yoto OAuth Client Secret (Optional)
client_secret.description: Optional OAuth 2.0 Client Secret if your Yoto application is confidential.

auth_base_url.title: Yoto Auth Base URL
auth_base_url.description: Upstream Yoto OAuth 2.0 authorization server base URL.

token_expires_at.title: Token Expiration Timestamp
token_expires_at.description: ISO-8601 expiration timestamp of the current access token.

auth.title: Yoto Account
auth.description: Link your Yoto account via OAuth 2.0 PKCE or paste a Yoto access token.

actions.name: send_to_yoto
actions.title: Send to Yoto
actions.description: Upload audiobook tracks to a new or existing Yoto Make Your Own (MYO) playlist card.

tools.name: list_playlists
tools.description: List the user's Yoto Make Your Own (MYO) playlist cards.

query.description: Optional search query to filter playlist cards by title.

tools.name: send_to_yoto
tools.description: Send a Shelfd audiobook or series to a new or existing Yoto Make Your Own (MYO) card.

target_type.description: Target entity type ('book' or 'series'). Defaults to 'book'.

target_id.description: Shelfd book ID or series ID.

playlist_mode.description: Whether to create a new MYO card, append to an existing card, or replace an existing card.

card_id.description: Existing Yoto cardId (required when playlist_mode is 'append' or 'replace').

playlist_title.description: Title for a newly created or replaced Yoto MYO card.
